nodes.body:
2\. Malformed catalog data reaches ui logic 📘 Rule violation ≡ Correctness 
_record_mcp_recovery_review performs only ad-hoc Mapping and profile_id checks before passing
raw record dictionaries into local_profile_readiness. If one record contains a malformed nested
field such as non-mapping env_placeholders, snapshot construction raises and the shared exception
handler replaces the entire catalog with empty collections, including valid sibling servers.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description The reviewed catalog uses manual shape checks and then passes loosely typed dictionaries into UI readiness logic instead of validating them through a Pydantic model. ## Fix Focus Areas - tldw_chatbook/UI/MCP_Modules/mcp_workbench.py[3396-3405] - tldw_chatbook/MCP/readiness.py[366-389] ## Recommended Fix Define or reuse a Pydantic model describing every local catalog field, validate each service result at this boundary, and pass only validated model data into catalog and readiness construction. Handle validation errors through the existing safe refresh-failure path without exposing raw values. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools

1\. Catalog refresh has no unit coverage 📘 Rule violation ▣ Testability 
_record_mcp_recovery_review now reads, validates, transforms, and conditionally publishes the
restored catalog based on view-token ownership. The added test exercises those branches only through
a complete Textual application journey, leaving the changed method without the separately required
isolated unit test.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description The new catalog publication logic has integration coverage but no isolated unit coverage, despite the checklist requiring both forms of testing for non-trivial changed logic. ## Fix Focus Areas - tldw_chatbook/UI/MCP_Modules/mcp_workbench.py[3392-3428] - Tests/Backup_Recovery/test_mcp_recovery_catalog.py[99-104] ## Recommended Fix Add focused unit tests for successful conversion, malformed catalog results, reader exceptions, and stale recovery tokens using a minimal workbench fixture and controlled service doubles. Keep the existing Textual journey as integration coverage. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
